Document generator

Create prefilled ammunition-control paperwork from the selected e581.

Working-copy control: CLAMS transfers data from the imported e581 into printable DA-form working copies. Verify the current APD edition, local ASP instructions, signatures, serial numbers, and approval requirements before use.
581

Initial DA Form 581

Recreates the issue document from the imported e581. Issue lines are paginated at no more than seven DODICs per page and retain DODIC, NSN, lot, unit, ASP, dates, and location remarks.

Official APD record
DA Form 581 · Request for Issue and Turn-in of Ammunition
5515

DA Form 5515

Creates a training-ammunition control document for sub-hand receipt from the parent unit to a subordinate organization, supervisor, range OIC/NCOIC, or other authorized recipient.

Official APD record
DA Form 5515 · Training Ammunition Control Document
3020

DA Form 3020

Builds a magazine data card for each DODIC, lot, and selected storage location—including the main site and active caches—with opening receipt, allocation, and current balance entries.

DA Form 5692

Suggests Ammunition Consumption Certificate lines using the supporting-ASP DODIC profile and CLVYB CIIC. The user can add or remove lines before printing.
